Join to apply for the Agente Comercial role at AG Capital - Auditoria Tributária Previdenciária

Agente Comercial Autônomo - Grupo AG Capital

"A reforma do sistema de impostos brasileiro exigirá ainda mais atenção das organizações, especialmente durante o período de transição".

Diante deste cenário, o Grupo AG Capital busca Agentes Comerciais Autônomos com espírito empreendedor, paixão por vendas e desejo de construir uma carreira de sucesso baseada em resultados.

Se você busca flexibilidade, alta remuneração por performance e a oportunidade de representar uma marca consolidada no mercado, esta é a sua chance!

Sobre o Grupo AG Capital

Somos uma empresa em constante crescimento, destaque na revista Exame no ranking Negócios em Expansão (edição de 2025), e reconhecida pela IT Fórum entre as 100+ Inovadoras em TI (2024).

Reconhecida como a primeira TaxTech do país, desenvolvemos tecnologia pioneira para identificar ativos ocultos em tributos pagos a maior nos últimos 5 anos.

Nosso objetivo é aumentar o fluxo de caixa das empresas e garantir compliance tributário.

Sua Missão

Como Agente Comercial Autônomo, você será responsável por:

  1. Prospecção ativa e qualificação de novos clientes B2B.
  2. Apresentação e comercialização das soluções e serviços do Grupo AG Capital.
  3. Construção e manutenção de relacionamentos sólidos com clientes.
  4. Negociação e fechamento de contratos, buscando superar metas.
  5. Identificação de novas oportunidades de mercado e tendências.

O Que Buscamos Em Você

  • Experiência comprovada em vendas, preferencialmente autônoma ou por comissão.
  • Habilidades de comunicação, negociação e persuasão.
  • Autonomia, organização e alta capacidade de autogestão.
  • Orientação para resultados e resiliência.
  • Conhecimento básico do pacote Office.
  • Preferencialmente com CNPJ ativo ou disposição para formalizar.

O Que o Grupo AG Capital Oferece

  • Comissionamento agressivo e atrativo por vendas efetivadas.
  • Total autonomia para gerenciar sua rotina e horários.
  • Suporte comercial e material de apoio (treinamentos, apresentações etc.).
  • Oportunidade de trabalhar com um portfólio de soluções relevantes e de alta demanda.
  • Ambiente de trabalho colaborativo e focado no crescimento.
  • Potencial de ganhos ilimitados e reconhecimento por sua performance.

Local de atuação: Remoto (eventuais treinamentos presenciais na sede ou filiais do Grupo AG Capital).

Resumo da vaga

Join to apply for the Orientador(a) de Loja - Camaçari role at RD Saúde

Descrição da vaga
Na RD Saúde , você é o primeiro sorriso que acolhe, garantindo uma experiência única. Aqui, você tem a oportunidade de unir atendimento humanizado, empatia e propósito em um ambiente que valoriza seu desenvolvimento e crescimento. Somos líderes no mercado brasileiro de farmácias, com lojas em todo o país e mais de 60 mil pessoas apaixonadas por cuidar de gente . Trilhamos um caminho de desenvolvimento que impulsiona carreiras e transforma futuros. Juntos por uma sociedade de mais saudável impactamos mais de 1 milhão de vidas e queremos ir ainda mais longe — de forma sólida, humana e lado a lado com você. Venha fazer parte dessa jornada e trilhar um caminho que transforma carreiras e futuros.
#Seja RD Saúde e venha transformar vidas com a gente!

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Formação acadêmica mínima: Ensino médio completo;
  • Faixa etária: mínimo 18 anos;
  • Disponibilidade: Imediata, trabalho por escala;
  • Experiência: Não se preocupe. Se você ainda não tiver, a gente te ensina!

Informações adicionais

  • Salário e benefícios: Compatíveis com o mercado;
  • Local De Trabalho
    Farmácia (Loja);
  • Escala de Trabalho: Escala 5x1 em formato carrossel, com folgas rotativas e folga de domingo a cada 3 semanas, jornada de 7h20 por dia e bônus de 4h mensais.
  • São mais de 40 benefícios pensados pra você e pra sua família.
  • Programa de Participação nos Resultados;
  • Trilha de carreira;
  • Convênio com empresas parceiras;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Vale transporte;
  • Vale refeição e/ou alimentação;
  • Cesta de Natal;
  • Benefício farmácia e vacinação;
  • Assistência odontológica;
  • Assistência médica e telemedicina;
  • Auxilio-academia;
  • Licença maternidade e paternidade estendida;
  • Day Off de aniversário, no seu e dos filhos(as) + presente pra você;
  • Universidade com cursos pra você e família;
  • Fundo de emergência (apoio financeiro em momentos de crise);
  • Consultoria de planejamento e organização financeira;
  • Auxílio creche e kit bebê para mamães na RD Saúde;
  • Auxílio funeral;

Juntos por uma sociedade mais saudável
Somos RD Saúde, um ecossistema de saúde integral, com mais de 3 mil unidades em todo o Brasil e negócios em saúde que dividem o mesmo propósito: contribuir para uma sociedade mais saudável. Nossa jornada começou em novembro de 2011, fruto da união entre Raia e Drogasil, crescendo até se tornar a maior rede de farmácias do Brasil e expandindo para além do varejo farmacêutico, integrando soluções B2B e plataformas digitais. Com mais de um milhão de vidas atendidas diariamente em todo o país, cuidar de perto dos(as) nossos(as) clientes e das nossas pessoas está em nosso DNA. Somos mais de 57 mil profissionais comprometidos em construir o futuro da saúde com calor humano e tecnologia. Temos a sustentabilidade no centro da nossa estratégia, dividindo nossa ambição em três pilares: pessoas, negócio e planeta mais saudáveis.

description:
Somos ávidos por tecnologia, criatividade e desafios. Se você gosta de desafios, aprendizado constante e valoriza as conexões pessoais, junte-se a nós!

# Valorizamos a diversidade e acreditamos que ela é fundamental para a inovação e entregas de valor aos nossos clientes. Todas as nossas vagas são destinadas a todas as pessoas, com ou sem deficiência, independentemente de idade, gênero, orientação sexual, etnia, religião ou qualquer outra característica. Se você se identifica com a posição, venha fazer parte do nosso time!

O QUE BUSCAMOS?

Buscamos um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Dados , em níveis de carreira Pleno ou Sênior , que queiram trabalhar conosco em um ambiente descontraído e dinâmico, com aprendizado contínuo no desenvolvimento de grandes projetos, junto a grandes clientes nacionais e internacionais. Temos escritórios em Maringá, São Paulo e Chicago (EUA), mas a nossa atuação é remota: por aqui preferimos chamar de anywhere office.

O QUE ESSE PROFISSIONAL IRÁ FAZER?

  • Projetar, construir e manter pipelines de dados robustos (ETL/ELT) e modelos analíticos, desde a ingestão de fontes brutas até a camada de consumo (arquitetura medalhão: bronze, silver, gold).
  • Implementar e disseminar melhores práticas de desenvolvimento, testes, monitoramento e performance para dados em larga escala.
  • Criar validações, testes automatizados e tratamentos de erros para assegurar qualidade, integridade e consistência dos dados.
  • Garantir escalabilidade, resiliência, segurança e alta performance da plataforma e dos pipelines.
  • Documentar lógica de negócio, regras de transformação e fluxos de dados.

O QUE É NECESSÁRIO PARA A POSIÇÃO?

  • Inglês intermediário/avançado para comunicação com equipes globais.
  • Experiência comprovada como Engenheiro(a) de Dados em ambientes de grande escala.
  • Domínio avançado de SQL (DDL, DML, otimização e estruturas complexas).
  • Maestria em Python para manipulação de dados e desenvolvimento de soluções de engenharia.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de orquestração, especialmente Apache Airflow.
  • Conhecimento sólido em arquitetura de dados e plataformas AWS ou GCP.
  • Vivência com Git e práticas de CI/CD aplicadas a projetos de dados.
  • Capacidade de projetar e implementar soluções de observabilidade e resiliência de dados.

O QUE SERIA UM DIFERENCIAL?

  • Experiência com outras ferramentas de orquestração ou workflow.
  • Certificações em cloud (AWS, GCP ou Azure).
  • Conhecimento em DataOps e práticas avançadas de monitoramento de dados.
  • Experiência com processamento distribuído (Spark, Databricks, Hadoop).

ETAPAS DO PROCESSO:

  • Inscrição
  • Fit cultural
  • Entrevista técnica
  • Entrevista com o cliente
  • Contratação

Overview

RD Station - Pessoa Assistente de Dados - Produto & Engenharia (vaga afirmativa para pessoas com deficiência)

Quer fazer parte de um time que cria oportunidades e potencializa a evolução?

Nosso jeito de ser

Potencializamos a evolução: Transformamos ideias em realidade em uma empresa dinâmica e inovadora. Fazer parte deste time, significa aprender, criar e evoluir.

Bem-Estar Integral : Buscamos o bem-estar integral de cada pessoa colaboradora, por meio de ações e benefícios que viabilizam recursos de autocuidado através de 5 pilares: Emocional, Financeiro, Físico, Ocupacional e Social.

Pluralidade : A diversidade faz parte de quem a gente é. Reconhecidos entre as Melhores Empresas para Trabalhar no Brasil, promovemos a inclusão e o pertencimento de forma ativa. Nossa expertise é humana e viva, e através dela, acolhemos e empoderamos pessoas dentro e fora da empresa.

Desafio do time

Nosso time tem como missão facilitar a tomada de decisão em Produto & Engenharia (P&E), atuando como ponte entre dados de produto e negócios. Estamos embedados nas alianças de produto e focados em aumentar a produtividade e democratizar o acesso aos dados em toda a organização de P&E. Com o crescimento constante da área, enfrentamos o desafio de gerenciar um volume crescente de dashboards e relatórios, mantendo-os atualizados, documentando fontes de dados e automatizando diagnósticos para garantir qualidade e eficiência.

Responsabilidades

  • Organizar e documentar ativos de dados, mantendo inventário de dashboards no Power BI e glossário centralizado de métricas e indicadores;
  • Monitorar a saúde e qualidade dos relatórios, realizando checagens de rotina e gerenciando permissões de acesso;
  • Atuar como primeiro ponto de contato para dúvidas frequentes sobre dados no Slack, direcionando análises complexas para analistas responsáveis;
  • Apoiar rituais e processos internos, preparando materiais e acompanhando planos de ação;
  • Incrementar o repertório do agente de IA;
  • Bons conhecimentos em Google Sheets e Google Docs, com alta capacidade de organização e comunicação;
  • Habilidade para coleta e manipulação de dados para apoiar analistas de dados;
  • Organização para gerenciar múltiplas tarefas e manter documentação atualizada;
  • Atenção aos detalhes para garantir precisão na verificação de dados e manutenção dos dashboards;
  • Proatividade e curiosidade para aprender e se desenvolver na área de dados;

Qualificações

Será considerado um diferencial

  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de BI como Power BI, Power Query ou Looker;
  • Noções básicas de SQL;
  • Conhecimento avançado em planilhas, incluindo AppScript;
  • Experiência prévia em análise de business intelligence ou áreas correlatas em produto;
  • Formação superior em áreas quantitativas (Estatística, Economia, Engenharia, Ciência da Computação ou afins).

Conformidade e Privacidade

Nos comprometemos com a segurança dos seus dados! Em nosso Aviso de Privacidade, descrevemos quais dados coletamos, como são consumidos e armazenados, em conformidade com a LGPD.

Se você é movido por desafios, criatividade e impacto genuíno

avance conosco nessa jornada de evolução! Faça parte do nosso time!

Sobre a OceanPact

A OceanPact é uma empresa brasileira especializada em serviços marítimos, atuando com excelência nas áreas de meio ambiente, engenharia e logística offshore. Com presença sólida no mercado e atuação em todo o território nacional, oferecemos soluções integradas e sustentáveis para os desafios do mar. Nosso propósito é transformar o cuidado com o mar em valor para todos.

Sobre a vaga

Estamos em busca de um(a) Auxiliar de Operador de Sistemas Remotos para atuar em operações offshore, apoiando atividades técnicas e operacionais em embarcações. Essa posição é essencial para garantir a eficiência nas operações marítimas e no uso de sistemas remotos.

Responsabilidades

  • Realizar trabalhos técnicos afins a sua área de formação;
  • Desempenhar funções de apoio operacional na seção de convés de embarcações, auxiliando em manobras, transporte de cargas; procedimentos de segurança e manutenção;
  • Conduzir embarcação compatível com a sua habilitação em operações de batimetria, testes no mar etc.;
  • Tripular embarcações remotamente pilotadas;
  • Preparar os equipamentos para serem lançados no mar, incluindo mobilização de embarcações, limpeza, abastecimento, montagem de boias, sensores, gliders etc.

Requisitos

  • Obrigatórios
    • Curso de Marinheiro Auxiliar de Convés;
    • Ensino Médio Técnico em Mecânica ou Mecatrônica;
    • Inglês Básico;
    • Pacote Office Básico.
  • Desejáveis
    • Curso de soldagem.

Local de trabalho

  • Cidade Universitária, Parque Tecnológico UFRJ - Rio de Janeiro

O que buscamos

  • Queremos Pessoas Que Se Identifiquem Com Os Nossos Valores
  • Dá pra fazer, com responsabilidade e qualidade
  • O jeito certo: ética, segurança e excelência
  • Gostamos do que fazemos: entusiasmo e envolvimento
  • Confiança: relações transparentes e comprometidas
  • Inovação: melhoria contínua e novas ideias
  • Resultados: foco em entregas com valor

O que oferecemos

  • Pacote de remuneração compatível com o mercado, com salário fixo e benefícios competitivos
  • Plano de saúde e odontológico, para você e sua família, porque cuidar de quem cuida importa
  • Vale-refeição e/ou alimentação, além de vale-transporte (ou auxílio mobilidade, conforme o modelo de trabalho)
  • Ambiente de trabalho colaborativo, seguro e ético, onde o cuidado com as pessoas e o mar são levados a sério
  • Oportunidades reais de desenvolvimento profissional, com participação em projetos relevantes, treinamentos e contato com equipes multidisciplinares
  • Cultura forte e propósito claro, em uma empresa brasileira sólida, que cresce com responsabilidade e inovação
  • Estabilidade e confiança, em uma organização que atua com excelência e compromisso no setor marítimo e offshore

title: Agente De Vendas
description:
Overview

Vaga: Assistente de Atendimento ao Cliente – Noceci Viagens. Modalidade: Home Office (com possibilidade de reuniões presenciais ocasionais no RJ).

Resumo do Cargo

Na Noceci Viagens, acreditamos que viajar é criar memórias transformadoras. O(a) Assistente de Atendimento será peça-chave para oferecer aos clientes uma experiência diferenciada desde o primeiro contato até o pós-venda. O sucesso neste cargo será alcançado através da escuta ativa, empatia, organização e capacidade de oferecer soluções rápidas e assertivas. Este cargo se conecta diretamente com o propósito da Noceci: democratizar o acesso a experiências únicas, com foco especial na África, mas também em qualquer destino no mundo.

Responsabilidades

  • Atender clientes via WhatsApp, e-mail e telefone, garantindo comunicação clara, ágil e acolhedora.
  • Realizar pesquisas e montar cotações de voos, hospedagens, pacotes e serviços de viagem utilizando consolidadoras, operadoras e estratégias com milhas.
  • Apoiar na criação e envio de propostas personalizadas, alinhadas ao perfil do cliente.
  • Registrar e atualizar informações no CRM (Iddas Agência e BotConversa).
  • Dar suporte no pós-venda, acompanhando clientes antes, durante e após a viagem.
  • Auxiliar na gestão de dados e relatórios de atendimento, identificando pontos de melhoria.
  • Manter relacionamento com fornecedores e parceiros estratégicos.

Qualificações

  • Experiência prévia em atendimento ao cliente (preferencialmente no setor de turismo, operadoras e/ou consolidadoras).
  • Conhecimento em emissão de passagens aéreas, uso de milhas e montagem de pacotes turísticos.

title: Clinical Manager in CNS  - LATAM
description:
Join to apply for the Clinical Manager role at IQVIA .

IQVIA provides scientific services spanning clinical trials, real world evidence, and consulting in all areas of the product lifecycle. The Patient Centered Solutions (PCS) team leads the industry in generating data to ensure that the patient voice is incorporated into the development and commercialization of medication and other drug/non-drug interventions. We focus on understanding and meeting the needs of our clients – mostly life science/pharmaceutical companies – through the application of broad consulting expertise and technical scientific knowledge to design scientifically rigorous research. This research is broad and includes qualitative (e.g. interviews, focus groups), quantitative (e.g. clinical outcome assessments (COAs)/patient-reported outcomes (PROS), preference research) and passive (e.g. digital health technology tools) approaches to understand patient, caregiver and healthcare professional experiences and expectations of disease and treatment.

To meet our client expectations and retain the excellent reputation built up over time the IQVIA PCS team is committed to recruiting, training and supporting driven individuals who have both consulting skills and life science skills that can be applied to PCS research activities . Individuals joining us are assured of a rewarding and progressive career in patient-focused research. You’ll have the opportunity to address challenging client issues, across multiple geographies with a hands-on influence in developing and delivering solutions . We operate in a truly multi-cultural, collegial and collaborative work environment that is rich in development and growth.

Role & Responsibilities

The role-holder will need to be a committed individual, who combines high emotional intelligence and excellent communication skills. They will thrive in a fast-paced environment and be comfortable managing conflicting priorities. The environment is dynamic and ever-changing, moving at the pace of our clients’ needs and the candidate will be expected to understand the sense of urgency that is synonymous with the business.

As a Consultant, ClinRO Services within the PCS team at IQVIA, you will directly administer assessments to participants in a clinical trial, or evaluate the quality of assessments performed by others and provide feedback regarding interview technique and scoring . Responsibilities include:

  • Review of scales administered by raters in a clinical trial to ensure that assessments are being conducted in a standardized manner to ensure data reliability.
  • Evaluate the quality of assessments, conducting live interactions with raters to discuss assessment methodology, scoring technique, and to provide guidance, as necessary.
  • Evaluate case data and appropriately prepare for discussions with raters (e.g., prepared to discuss relevant issues and scale items, and have necessary documents available).
  • Complete rater interactions and assigned tasks as scheduled.
  • Responsible for timely submission of all documentation associated with assigned tasks.
  • Participate in all orientation, training and calibration activities as required.
  • Functional assessments of rater performance (e.g., mock interview) and assistance in preparing and disseminating communications.
  • Contacting clinical trial participants remotely (e.g., via proprietary app, Engage) to administer assessments, and will appropriately document resultant information (e.g., notes, scores).

What do you need to apply?

  • Minimum of a Master’s degree (MA/MS) in Psychology, Counseling, Psychiatric, Nursing or Social Work, or equivalent.
  • Minimum of 3 years clinical experience working with central nervous system (CNS) trials preferred. Experience working with related psychiatric populations & experience administering psychiatric assessments, ratings scales and/or structured clinical interviews is a plus.
  • Ideally this person should have previous experience in Alzheimer's disease, Parkinson's disease, depression, schizophrenia, anxiety.
  • Advanced level of English.
  • Strong interpersonal skills with ability to interact with all levels of personnel and clientele in a professional manner.
  • Excellent organization, attention to detail, time management and problem solving skills.
  • Strong computer skills, including Microsoft Office applications (solid excel/power point knowledge).

Home based position in Latin America.

IQVIA is a leading global provider of clinical research services, commercial insights and healthcare intelligence to the life sciences and healthcare industries. We create intelligent connections to accelerate the development and commercialization of innovative medical treatments to help improve patient outcomes and population health worldwide. Learn more at

About Patrianna
Patrianna is a fast-growing global business on a mission to deliver life-changing moments of joy to our customers. We’re proudly headquartered in Gibraltar, at the southern tip of Europe - but we think beyond borders, recruiting top talent from anywhere in the world.

At Patrianna, you’ll join a driven and collaborative team where ownership is encouraged, learning is constant, and your work has real impact. We believe in empowering people to thrive - personally and professionally - through trust, autonomy, and shared purpose.

Please ensure you submit your application in English.

Overview
We’re looking for a QA Agent who’s passionate about safeguarding our players and ensuring operational excellence within Payments, Risk, and Fraud. This role ensures that every decision and process within Player Operations meets the highest standards of accuracy, compliance, and fairness through detailed audits, clear feedback, and continuous improvement.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Act as the quality expert within the Player Operations (Payments, Risk & Fraud) team, driving best practices and consistency.

  • Perform root cause analyses (RCAs) on errors or escalations to identify systemic issues and recommend process improvements.
  • Participate in calibration sessions to align quality expectations across internal teams and external partners.
  • Review escalated cases, customer complaints, and payment disputes, providing well-documented recommendations for resolution.
  • Maintain and update QA process documentation as fraud and risk workflows evolve.
  • Prepare weekly and monthly QA reports highlighting trends, gaps, and recommendations for process improvement.
  • Contribute to team discussions focused on refining fraud detection, payment verification, and risk prevention frameworks.
  • Support special projects or tasks that arise - bringing flexibility and initiative to the role.

What You Bring

  • iGaming or gambling industry experience is a must.
  • Proven experience in a QA, risk, fraud, or payments-related role.
  • Strong analytical skills with a proactive, problem-solving mindset.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to deliver clear and constructive feedback.
  • High attention to detail and a commitment to maintaining accuracy, compliance, and consistency.
  • Familiarity with fraud/risk tools, payment systems, and player verification processes.
  • Ability to work independently in a dynamic, remote-first environment.

Why Join Patrianna?

  • Growth & Continuous Learning Learn by doing, take ownership of projects, and grow your career in a supportive, fast-evolving team.
  • Ego-Free Collaboration Work with people who value respect, open communication, and shared success—no egos, no politics.
  • Ownership & Accountability Be trusted to lead, contribute ideas, and deliver real outcomes. Your voice and actions matter here.
  • Purpose & Impact You’re not just checking boxes - you’re helping shape meaningful experiences for our customers every day.
  • Flexibility & Rewards Enjoy the freedom to work in ways that suit you, backed by a culture that recognises effort and celebrates impact.

Important Requirements

  • Willingness to work outside on a shifting schedule/weekend/holidays
  • You will need your own office set up with a self-provided laptop or PC, headset and a reliable internet connection with the below requirements:
    • PC – Intel i3-10100 (4C/8T @ 3.6-4.3GHz) or AMD Ryzen 3 3200G – self provided
    • Minimum OS Version: Windows 11 or higher
    • Internet browser (preferably Chrome – but can use Edge, Firefox, etc.)
    • Minimum RAM: 16 GB
    • Minimum HDD Space: 1 GB
    • Headset: USB Headset (noise-canceling)
    • Web Camera (for team meetings)
    • Internet: Ethernet/Hardline Connection, speed minimum of 10Mbps Upload & Download Internet speed is required.
    • Backup Internet provider

title: Sales Development Representative
description:
Overview

Sales Development Representative at The WFS Group. This role focuses on outbound and inbound sales activity to generate qualified appointments and build revenue pipelines for closer roles within a high-ticket environment.

Base pay range

$4.00/hr - $5.00/hr

Job Description

In our world, high ticket means a price point of about $10k or above. WFS Group seeks talented sales professionals to generate appointments and revenue through outbound dialing (cold and warm) and inbound screening. The SDR will call leads that have opted in to our marketing campaigns, qualify interest, and set qualified sales appointments for closers. The role emphasizes fast-paced, high-output activity with a focus on creating a strong pipeline and revenue growth for WFS Group.

Responsibilities

  • Generate leads and schedule appointments for product presentations and sales pitches.
  • Arrange and coordinate meetings between prospective customers and closers.
  • Attend sales team meetings and training sessions as directed by management.
  • Follow up with potential customers who expressed interest but didn’t commit to move forward.
  • Continuously increase product knowledge by engaging with sales training content.
  • Participate in daily sales syncs to discuss initiatives, review call performance, and plan the pipeline.
  • Engage in discovery dialogue to identify challenges and buying motivation for WFS offers.
  • Build relationships with leads using a consultative approach to understand goals and needs.
  • Utilize WFS sales materials to ensure leads review content prior to calls with closers.
  • Achieve or exceed sales appointment quotas and targets.
  • Adhere to CRM practices to track leads, follow-ups, and forecast accurately.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure a smooth sales process.
  • Demonstrate WFS core values to contribute to a high-performance culture.

Requirements

  • 6 months of previous experience as an SDR or appointment setter in a high-ticket or consultative sales process.
  • Effective communication and presentation skills.
  • Self-starter with a strong drive for success.
  • Ability to work independently and manage time effectively.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to build rapport.
  • Experience with CRM systems.

Application guidance

  • You SHOULD apply if you’re motivated to be a top producer and have experience in phone/Zoom sales, are coachable, and capable of high-output dialing.
  • You should NOT apply if you do not meet the listed requirements or prefer not to work in a structured team with other top performers.

Employment type & schedule

  • Job Type: Independent Contractor
  • Schedule: Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM (US Time Zones)

Compensation & benefits

  • Base pay: $4-$5 per hour
  • Bonus opportunities
  • Uncapped commission

title: Strategic Partnership & Alliance
description:
About RateGain
RateGain Travel Technologies Limited is a global provider of AI-powered SaaS solutions for travel and hospitality that works with 3,200+ customers and 700+ partners in 100+ countries helping them accelerate revenue generation through acquisition, retention, and wallet share expansion. RateGain today is one of the world’s largest processors of electronic transactions, price points, and travel intent data helping revenue management, distribution and marketing teams across hotels, airlines, meta-search companies, package providers, car rentals, travel management companies, cruises and ferries drive better outcomes for their business.
Founded in 2004 and headquartered in India, today RateGain works with 26 of the Top 30 Hotel Chains, 25 of the Top 30 Online Travel Agents, 4 of the Top 5 Airlines, and all the top car rentals, including 16 Global Fortune 500 companies in unlocking new revenue every day.
Exploring the role
RateGain is privileged to partner with hotels of every size and type around the world to achieve their commercial objectives – from independent, luxury, lifestyle, and boutique hotels, to the world’s largest chains. Chains - and multi-site operators - have unique business requirements, additional complexity, and often use more diverse technology solutions. As a partner of choice for global and regional chains, RateGain is looking to further serve this important segment of the hospitality industry and seeks an experienced Director focused on European markets, to further scale this essential unit of our business.
The ideal candidate will understand how Latam hotel chains function and operate, and will be familiar with the technology solutions adopted by these chains to achieve their commercial objectives. The role requires a trusted advisor, able to assist chains to manage through the complexities of the travel technology eco system to guide them to the right decisions in the areas of distribution, business intelligence, marketing technologies, and beyond.
This is an individual contributor role and, as such, the candidate is expected to be a self-started and self-driven, ready to innovate to find new values for our hotel chain clients whilst keeping the company goals and the bigger picture firmly in mind. This position can be based anywhere in Latam and needs to have the ability to travel within the Latam without limitations.
How your day will look like/Job responsibility
Build and manage strategic alliances with regional and local partners (e.g. RMS, PMS, booking engines, OTAs)
Define and execute a partnership roadmap aligned with RateGain’s GTM strategy in LATAM
Identify co-marketing, co-selling, and integration opportunities with key players in the hospitality and travel ecosystem
Collaborate with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Product, Legal) to structure and execute partnership agreements
Represent RateGain in industry events and partnership meetings to promote our brand and solutions
Monitor partner performance, engagement, and contribution to pipeline and revenue
Provide regular reporting and insights on partnership outcomes and market trends
Education & Work Experience
Bachelor’s degree in business, Marketing, or a related field
5+ years of experience in business development or strategic partnerships
Knowledge:
In-depth understanding of the LATAM hospitality and travel technology ecosystem
Knowledge of SaaS business models and partnership structures
Awareness of regional trends, customer behavior, and competitive landscape in the travel and hospitality sectors
Skills:
Strong negotiation and deal-closing capabilities
Excellent relationship management skills with ability to engage partners at all levels
Advanced verbal and written communication skills in
Spanish, Portuguese, and English
Ability to identify, pitch, and convert strategic partnership opportunities
Proficiency in using CRM and sales enablement tools
Skilled in cross-functional collaboration with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Legal, Product, etc.)
Attitude:
Proactive and results-oriented, with a strong drive to exceed targets
Entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for growth and innovation
Culturally sensitive and collaborative, with the ability to work effectively in a global, remote team
High level of integrity, professionalism, and ownership
Resilient and adaptable in a fast-paced and evolving environment
Equal Opportunity Employer
We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to providing a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome and encourage applications from all qualified individuals, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, genetic information, disability, or veteran status.

title: Lead Python Engineer
description:
About Kyros
Kyros is a next-generation actuarial software platform, bringing together advanced modeling, interactive visualization, and automated workflows into a unified system. It helps actuarial teams move faster from analysis to delivery by combining powerful data processing with intuitive web applications.
Position Overview
We’re seeking a
Senior Software Developer & Lead
with deep expertise in Python and web application development who thrives on building momentum around technical initiatives. This role sits at the intersection of hands-on technical execution, software architecture leadership, and inspiring engineering excellence across unified teams.
Key Innovation:
This position leads our transition from siloed development teams (Plotly visualization, data modeling tools) into a unified software development organization focused on integrated product solutions. You’ll spend 60-70% of your time writing high-quality code, while also rallying the team around best practices, mentoring developers, and championing our long-term vision of continuous value delivery.
As both technical contributor and team leader, you’ll set the bar for code quality, help improve developer experience, and drive enthusiasm for our evolution toward CI/CD, test automation, and release-on-demand workflows. You’ll also participate in strategic quarterly planning sessions, providing technical feasibility input and capacity reality alongside our Actuarial Solutions Architect and Client Delivery Team Leads.
Key Responsibilities
Technical Leadership & Architecture (60–70%)
Lead by example – Write production-quality Python applications that demonstrate excellent coding standards, comprehensive testing, and clear documentation.
Set the technical bar through exemplary code reviews, thoughtful PR comments, and mentorship that elevates the entire team’s capabilities.
Software architecture collaboration
– Work with existing software/systems architecture team members while developing capability to handle architectural decisions independently.
Modernize development practices
– Guide team evolution toward CI/CD, automated testing, and Kanban-based throughput optimization.
Champion AI-assisted development
– Model effective use of tools like Cursor and Claude Code to accelerate development workflows.
Excellence in acceptance criteria
– Drive development of comprehensive user acceptance criteria and ensure compliance with quality standards.
Team Leadership & Galvanizing (30–40%)
Unify development organization – Integrate separate Plotly and data modeling teams into cohesive group delivering integrated software solutions.
Champion technical initiatives and help the team get excited about new approaches, tools, and improvements.
Build consensus around architectural decisions and communicate the “why” behind technical choices to ensure buy-in.
Energize development processes – Lead daily standups, planning sessions, and retrospectives with enthusiasm that maintains team momentum.
Foster commitment and follow-through – Help team buy into quarterly commitments and establish accountability for delivering on promises made in retrospectives and planning sessions.
Mentor through collaboration – Provide “shoulder to shoulder” technical mentoring through pairing sessions, code reviews, and collaborative problem-solving rather than formal training programs.
Strategic Planning & Collaboration
Quarterly planning participation
– Work with Actuarial Solutions Architect and Client Delivery Team Leads to assess technical feasibility, provide capacity estimates, and ensure realistic quarterly commitments.
Process ownership evolution
– Implement agile and software disciplines with enterprise coaching support initially, then take increasing ownership of process improvements and team excellence initiatives.
Kanban and throughput optimization
– Work with cycle time, throughput, and other Kanban-based KPIs to optimize team performance.
Skills gap identification
– Assess team capabilities and coordinate development plans for junior developers eager to grow.
Technical Requirements
8+ years professional software development experience with strong Python expertise.
2+ years of leading experience
Experience with Azure Cloud
Web application development using frameworks like Flask, Djan, or FastAPI.
Database proficiency – SQL databases, query optimization, and data architecture decisions.
Testing discipline – Unit testing, integration testing, and automated testing practices including BDD and TDD methodologies.
Nice to have :
Data manipulation and scaling – Experience with large datasets, performance optimization, and data processing pipelines using pandas, numpy, and potentially pyspark.
CI/CD pipeline automation – Advanced automation and deployment optimization experience.
Machine Learning libraries – Experience with torch, pytorch, pytorch lightning, or similar ML frameworks (preferred but not required).
Big data processing – Experience with Databricks, Spark, or similar distributed data processing platforms
We offer:
We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule.
Personal laptop.
Health/Sport Budget.
Fully remote.

Yuna's mission is to radically transform the way mental health support is accessed and delivered. By providing 24/7 instant and private support at the push of a button, we aim to address the significant gaps in mental health care accessibility. In a system where waiting times for therapists can reach up to 48 days and many people can't even afford care, Yuna is the answer to immediate mental health support needs.
We’re growing quickly, and every person who joins us plays a pivotal role in shaping the future of mental health technology.
Position Overview
You’ll own Yuna’s core conversational intelligence (i.e. spanning retrieval, memory, safety, evaluation, and post-training). You’ll ship user-visible improvements quickly while raising the bar on empathy, reliability, and guardrails. This is a hands-on staff-level role: equal parts research-to-production and platform thinking.

Lead the end-to-end model lifecycle of Yuna’s conversational AI: problem framing → data curation → modeling/fine-tuning/post-training → evals → rollout → monitoring

Optimize for latency, cost, and quality
Partner tightly with product, sales, and users to scope new features and
Establish LLMOps: datasets, prompts/checkpoints/versioning, observability, drift monitoring, and incident response for model quality
What you’ll bring
5+ years in ML/AI with 3+ shipping LLM/NLP systems in production
Deep skill in Python and modern deep learning stacks (PyTorch/JAX/TensorFlow), retrieval/RAG, embeddings, reranking, and long-context summarization
Experience building agentic systems (tool calling, decomposition, memory) and rigorous eval harnesses (offline + online)
Strong product sense; you care about user outcomes, not just model metrics
Comfort working with ambiguity and creating systems 0 to 1
Location: Remote

Remote-first culture with flexibility

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
Context
We are a fast-growing startup that has experienced tremendous growth over the past months, achieving 8x revenue growth in the last 18 months and a 10x usage increase over the same period. As we continue this upward trajectory, we are expanding our team to ensure our products remain reliable, intuitive, and delightful for our ever-growing user base.
Mission
As a DevOps/Infrastructure team member, your primary mission will be to help ensuring that our infrastructure is scalable, reliable, and cost-effective, supporting the company’s rapid growth and evolving needs. You will play a critical role in both day-to-day operations and long-term strategic planning, helping shape our platform's future.
Key Responsibilities:
Infrastructure Scaling and Stability : Contribute to the continuous scaling of our infrastructure to handle increasing loads while maintaining stability and performance. This includes designing and implementing robust and scalable architectures, automating deployment processes, and optimizing resource allocation.
Performance Optimization : You will continuously monitor and analyze system performance, identifying bottlenecks and areas for improvement. You will also work on optimizing our infrastructure and applications to ensure low-latency, high-throughput operation, particularly for video and audio processing.
Cost Management : Implement strategies to optimize infrastructure costs without compromising performance. This includes rightsizing resources, automating scaling policies, and leveraging cloud provider cost-saving mechanisms.
Enhancing Observability : Improve our monitoring and observability capabilities, ensuring we have comprehensive visibility into the health and performance of our infrastructure. You will develop and maintain dashboards, alerts, and logs that provide actionable insights for the entire engineering team.
Collaboration and Support : Work closely with developers and other stakeholders to ensure seamless integration between infrastructure and applications. Provide guidance and support on infrastructure-related topics, fostering a culture of shared responsibility for the system’s reliability.
Security and Compliance : Contribute to the security and compliance of our infrastructure by implementing best practices and staying up-to-date with industry standards.
Innovation and Continuous Improvement : Stay abreast of industry trends and technologies and proactively suggest and implement improvements. You will have the opportunity to experiment with new tools and methodologies, driving innovation within the team.
Who We Are Looking For
We seek a highly skilled and experienced DevOps/Infrastructure Engineer who is passionate about building and maintaining scalable, reliable, and efficient infrastructure. You should have a strong background in managing complex environments across cloud providers and bare-metal servers and be comfortable working in high-performance environments, proactively identifying and resolving potential issues before they impact the system.
Key Qualifications:
Kubernetes
Mastery : Proven experience designing, deploying, and managing Kubernetes clusters in production environments.
Multi-Cloud and Bare Metal Expertise : Deep understanding of at least one primary cloud provider (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and experience managing infrastructure on bare-metal servers. You should be familiar with each environment’s unique challenges and opportunities and capable of leveraging their strengths effectively.
Infrastructure at Scale:
Demonstrated ability to architect and manage infrastructure that can scale horizontally and vertically, supporting a growing user base and increasing traffic. Experience with distributed systems, load balancing, and automated scaling strategies is essential.
Cost Optimization & Resource Management : Strong focus on optimizing infrastructure to balance performance and cost. You should be proficient in tools and techniques for monitoring resource usage, identifying inefficiencies, and implementing cost-saving measures.
Programming and Automation : Proficiency in scripting and automation (e.g.Bash, Python).
Monitoring and Observability : You should have a deep understanding of best practices for monitoring, logging, and observability. Experience with tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, ELK stack, or similar systems is crucial. You should also be able to design systems that provide comprehensive insights into infrastructure health and performance.
Problem-Solving Mindset : You should thrive on solving complex problems and constantly look for ways to improve system reliability, performance, and efficiency. Strong analytical skills and a methodical approach to troubleshooting are essential.
Collaboration and Communication : Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders. You should be comfortable collaborating across teams to ensure that infrastructure decisions support broader company goals.
Bonus Qualifications:
Experience with Media Processing : Familiarity with video and audio processing, streaming, or related technologies is a strong advantage. This includes understanding the performance implications and resource requirements of media workloads.
Familiarity with the Node.js environment and applications at scale is a strong advantage
Familiarity with configuration management tools like Ansible, Terraform, or Puppet is a plus

Responsabilidades e Atribuições:
Perfil Profissional – Desenvolvedor Java | Pleno
Desenvolvedor Java com sólida experiência em sistemas distribuídos e arquitetura de microsserviços, especializado em autenticação, autorização e protocolos de segurança como OAuth2, OpenID Connect e JWT. Atua com foco no desenvolvimento de mecanismos de Single Sign-On (SSO) para ambientes corporativos, garantindo segurança, escalabilidade e conformidade com padrões modernos de identidade digital.
Com domínio em Spring Security, Spring Authorization Server, Keycloak, Azure AD, Auth0 e outras soluções de identidade, projeta fluxos de autenticação robustos e integrações seguras entre múltiplos sistemas internos e externos. Possui expertise na implementação de Identity Providers (IdP), Resource Servers e Authorization Servers, bem como na configuração de clients OAuth2 com grant types como Authorization Code, Client Credentials, e Refresh Tokens.
Também é responsável por definir estratégias de controle de acesso baseado em roles (RBAC) e atributos (ABAC), configuração de políticas de autorização, integração com diretórios corporativos (LDAP, AD), e hardening de endpoints REST com escopos e claims personalizados.
Competências Técnicas
Linguagem: Java 8–21
Frameworks: Spring Boot, Spring Security, Spring Authorization Server, Apache Camel
SSO & Identity: OAuth2, OpenID Connect, JWT, SAML 2.0, Keycloak, Auth0, Azure Active Directory, Okta
Segurança: Criptografia, JWK/JWS, CORS, CSRF, PKCE
Integrações: LDAP, Active Directory, SCIM
Testes: Testcontainers, JUnit, Mockito, integração com testes de segurança
DevOps: Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD com Jenkins, GitLab ou GitHub Actions
Diferenciais
Experiência na migração de sistemas legados para arquiteturas modernas com SSO.
Atuação direta no desenho e implementação de Identity Providers e Authorization Servers próprios.
Capacidade de liderar times na definição de padrões de autenticação e segurança em ambientes corporativos.
Vivência com compliance de segurança, como LGPD e GDPR, aplicando princípios de privacy-by-design.

title: Social Media Producer
description:
*Vaga para Social Media*
Estamos em busca de uma Social Media proativa, executora e criativa, com olhar apurado para captação de conteúdo e atenção aos detalhes, para atuar no dia a dia da nossa loja.
O que você vai fazer:

  • Gravar vídeos do dia a dia com o celular (stories, bastidores, conteúdos leves e espontâneos)
  • Garantir que o cenário esteja sempre impecável (sem sujeiras, distrações ou aparelhos mal posicionados)
  • Trabalhar em dupla com outra Social Media que já grava bem, ajudando a orientar e incentivar as gravações
  • Criar ideias de conteúdos para stories e Reels de forma constante
  • Ajudar na criação de campanhas (como Black Friday, Natal, etc.)
  • Cumprir metas de conteúdo semanal, como gravações e postagens no feed
  • Manter o planejamento e organização das demandas (seguindo prazos e cronograma)
    O que a gente NÃO quer:
  • Alguém que só execute quando for cobrada
  • Falta de atenção nos detalhes visuais (aparelho mal limpo, cenário desorganizado, iluminação ruim)
  • Postagens e gravações feitas de qualquer jeito ou na correria
  • Falta de iniciativa e comprometimento com entregas e metas
    Perfil ideal:
  • Proatividade: não espera ordens para agir. Viu uma oportunidade de gravação? Vai lá e faz.
  • Visão estética: sabe o que é um cenário bonito, limpo, iluminado, com bom ângulo.
  • Criatividade: traz ideias diferentes para conteúdos do dia a dia e campanhas pontuais.
  • Organização: cumpre prazos, ajuda a planejar o conteúdo com antecedência.
  • Boa convivência: vai trabalhar em parceria com outra Social Media, então precisa somar.
  • Mão na massa: queremos quem coloca a mão na câmera, na edição e na entrega.
    Importante:
    Você não vai fazer vídeos de campanha com câmera profissional – isso já temos com um filmmaker. Mas precisa saber gravar com o celular, editar vídeos simples e entregar conteúdo com constância e qualidade.

title: Professor de italiano
description:
Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!
Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!
A
Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.
Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online:
você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.
Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de
22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco.
Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.
*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*
O que oferecemos?
Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
Acesso exclusivo a
uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos
de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis,
com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
Mentorias semanais
com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
Plataforma
exclusiva
para acompanhamento das aulas.
Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.
Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?
Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você .
Necessário:
Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais
para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.
O diferencial?
Aqui você é mais que um professor.
Você será parte de
uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.
Esta
não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.
Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.
Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a
ii
com certeza é o seu lugar.
Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas.
Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!
O que eu faço?
Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as
Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.
QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?
Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.
Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.
Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Desenvolvedor Fullstack Pleno
description:

Compartilhar conhecimento técnico, boas práticas e aprendizados com o time, fortalecendo a cultura de excelência e colaboração.

Experiência com versionamento de código utilizando GIT;

title: Senior Fullstack Engineer (React/Golang)
description:
About the Product
Niche
is the leader in school search. Our mission is to make researching and enrolling in schools easy, transparent, and free. With in-depth profiles on every school and college in America, 140 million reviews and ratings, and powerful search tools, we help millions of people find the right school for them. We also help thousands of schools recruit more best-fit students, by highlighting what makes them great and making it easier to visit and apply. Niche is all about finding where you belong, and that mission inspires how we operate every day. We want Niche to be a place where people truly enjoy working and can thrive professionally.
About the Role
We’re looking for a driven, resourceful, and experienced Senior Full Stack Software Engineer to join one of our growing product teams. As a senior member of the team, you will be tasked with designing, building, and enhancing services and user-facing features across our platform, with a strong focus on reliability, maintainability, scalability, and user experience. You’ll leverage your expertise spanning the entire stack, from database interactions to front-end libraries, contributing significantly to our technical direction and mentoring other engineers.
How you will make an impact
Design, develop, and maintain robust and scalable full-stack applications and features across a modern tech stack, including Typescript, React, Go and Postgres.
Focus on improving our user experience, collaborating with designers to implement intuitive interfaces and finding creative ways to reduce user pain points.
Build and enhance microservices, focusing on reliability, maintainability, and scalability within our distributed systems.
Ensure the quality of our products remains high by contributing to automated testing strategies and participating actively in code reviews.
Collaborate effectively with product managers, designers, QA analysts, and other engineers within an Agile development framework.
Contribute to engineering best practices, identifying and driving improvements in our processes, architecture, and technology stack.
Mentor junior and mid-level engineers, fostering a collaborative environment and sharing your expertise.
Distill user stories or business requirements into technical requirements and robust technical designs.
You may be a good fit for this role if you
Are passionate about coding and creating scalable systems and fantastic user experiences.
Embrace a growth mindset by continuously questioning established ideas and learning from your experiences.
Exhibit humility and a collaborative spirit, fostering a positive work environment while valuing the contributions of others without ego.
Value autonomy and empowerment to make your own decisions.
What you will do
During the 1st Month:
Attend onboarding sessions to better understand our internal processes and learn about the company
Pair with other engineers to learn more about our tech stack, the products we support, and our development standards and processes
Familiarize yourself with our automated testing platforms and begin to contribute to our test coverage
Collaborate with product team members to implement and ship small features and functionality
Within 3 Months:
Participate in code reviews and provide thoughtful, constructive feedback to other engineers
Gain exposure to the platform’s underlying infrastructure and deployment processes
Understand the high-level architecture of the website and back-end services
Begin shipping more complex user-facing code
Within 6 Months:
Grow as a contributing member of a product team, providing input and insight to the rest of the team on challenges and feasibility of proposed development
Confidently implement new functionality and fix bugs across our stack
Work with members of the tech and product teams to distill user stories or business requirements into technical requirements/design
Within 12 months:
Begin identifying areas for improvement in our codebase, researching best practices, and making recommendations to the team on strategies to address them
Solidify understanding of the breadth of our tech stack, including underlying infrastructure, internal tools, front end applications, and how they interact with our back-end services
Be a subject matter expert for the product team’s areas of responsibility
What we are looking for
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent experience
5+ years of professional software engineering experience
Experience with Typescript and React
Experience with one or more general-purpose programming languages (Go, C/C++, C#, Java, Ruby, etc.)
Experience with one or more SQL databases
Strong understanding of common data structures and design patterns
Experience working with a microservice architecture and distributed systems
Proficiency in using unit testing frameworks
A dedication to developing clear, reliable, and maintainable code
Proficiency with common git operations
Strong communication skills, effectively conveying ideas to both technical and non-technical partners
Experience mentoring other engineers

title: Principal AI Engineer - AI in Healthcare
description:
WHO WE ARE
We are a stealth-stage healthcare AI startup that is the missing link in healthcare revenue management, bridging the gap between clinical care and financial operations. We're transforming how primary care clinics capture revenue through innovative AI technology that operates at the intersection of medical documentation, billing, and value-based care compliance.
In an industry where medical providers leave approximately 16% of their revenue uncollected due to insurance denials and compliance gaps, our mission is clear: enable healthcare providers to capture every dollar they've earned while uncovering new revenue opportunities.
Founded by experienced entrepreneurs with successful exits in healthcare technology and backed by advisors from leading health insurance companies, we are building a virtuous cycle that improves both patient care and provider profitability. We've already secured our first client contract and are positioned for a major pilot.
Our technology tackles critical challenges facing healthcare providers:
Real-time AI guidance for physicians at point-of-care
Automated coding and billing optimization
Intelligent claim follow-up to reduce denials
Seamless compliance with value-based care requirements
Join us as we build technology that enables healthcare providers to thrive in an era of value-based care, maximizing revenues in primary care at scale.
WHY THIS ROLE IS PERFECT FOR YOU
This is your opportunity to shape production LLM applications that directly impact healthcare revenue and patient care. You'll work on a recently deployed AI system that automates medical coding and billing, evolving it from good to exceptional through meticulous refinement, rigorous testing, and continuous improvement.
You're not just implementing AI solutions—you're building a system that must get medical coding right the first time, understand complex insurance rules that change constantly, learn from denials, and continuously improve. Every line of code you write directly affects whether healthcare providers get paid and patients receive proper care.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Very hands-on—we're looking for a builder who obsesses over details!
1.
Build and Refine AI Products
Develop and implement new business rules for medical consultation billing codes, adapting to changes from various insurance providers
Propose and implement enhancements to our existing LLM-based products and optimize prompt engineering for maximum accuracy
Use AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor as part of your daily workflow to rapidly build and iterate on solutions
2.
Ensure Quality and Accuracy
Conduct extensive testing in staging environments and perform detailed debugging to ensure business rules are accurately implemented—in healthcare, "mostly right" isn't good enough
Verify data consistency from input to output to guarantee the solidity of our AI products
Monitor denial patterns and implement feedback loops that continuously improve model accuracy
3.
Own the Development Lifecycle
Be responsible for the entire process from understanding business rules to deploying and validating code in production
Debug complex system integrations and validate AI outputs against medical coding standards
4.
Collaborate and Drive Improvement
Work closely with AI, Tech, and Data Engineering teams to maintain complete understanding of the end-to-end process
Proactively identify critical issues, propose improvements, and stay current with new tools and techniques in the AI and LLM space
In the near future, contribute to fine-tuning specialized LLM models with our internal knowledge base
REQUIRED EXPERTISE
1.
Technical Skills
Strong proficiency in programming languages like Python or Go
Hands-on experience building products on top of large language models (LLMs)
Experience with LLM APIs (AWS Bedrock, OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, or similar)
Strong prompt engineering skills with focus on accuracy and consistency
Solid understanding of how LLMs work and how to leverage them for production applications
Comfortable working with cloud platforms (AWS preferred) and databases (PostgreSQL)
2.
Mindset & Approach
Meticulous attention to detail with a strong capacity for debugging and code validation
Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, ever-changing startup environment
Proven ability to learn new tools, frameworks, and business rules quickly
A self-starter who can work independently but also collaborate effectively within a small team
Possesses a "big picture" perspective, understanding how your work fits into the entire end-to-end process from client data entry to insurance billing
3.
Highly Valued Qualifications
Experience with AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar
Experience working in a startup or similar environment with constant change
Familiarity with RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) architectures
Experience with LLM orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar)
Previous experience in healthcare technology, particularly with medical coding, billing, or revenue cycle management
Healthcare Domain Knowledge: Not required, but you must be willing and able to learn medical coding, billing rules, and insurance requirements quickly. We'll teach you what you need to know.
WHAT WE OFFER
1.
Unparalleled Growth Opportunity
Ground-floor opportunity in a stealth-mode company with massive market potential
Direct impact on product direction and technical architecture decisions
Opportunity to build and lead a team as we scale
2.
Professional Excellence
Work alongside world-class engineers and healthcare industry veterans
Access to cutting-edge LLM technologies solving complex, real-world problems
Opportunity to influence architectural decisions as we scale our AI infrastructure
Competitive compensation package with significant equity upside
3.
Work-Life Integration
Fully remote position with flexible hours accommodating Brazil time zones
Fast-paced environment where you'll learn constantly and be challenged daily
Opportunity to work with prestigious American healthcare clients
Meaningful work that directly improves healthcare outcomes and provider sustainability
READY FOR THE CHALLENGE?
If you're a principal-level engineer who loves production AI systems, thrives on continuous improvement, obsesses over getting details right, and wants to make a real impact in healthcare, this role offers the perfect combination of technical challenge, business impact, and startup energy.
Apply now and help us transform healthcare revenue management through the power of data and AI.

title: Data Lead
description:
About YipitData:
YipitData is the market-leading data and analytics firm and raised up to $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation over $1B in its latest funding round. We analyze billions of data points every day to provide accurate, detailed insights across industries, including consumer brands, technology, software, and healthcare.
Our data team uses proprietary technology to identify, license, clean, and analyze the data that many of the world’s largest investment funds and corporations depend on.
For three years and counting, we have been recognized as one of Inc’s Best Workplaces. As a fast-growing company backed by The Carlyle Group and Norwest Venture Partners, YipitData is driven by a people-first culture rooted in mastery, ownership, and transparency.
With offices in New York, Austin, Miami, Denver, Mountain View, Seattle, Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, and Singapore, we continue to expand our reach and impact across global markets.
About the Role:
We’re seeking a highly motivated, team-oriented Data Lead to drive data strategy and execution across a best-in-class portfolio of data products. In this role, you’ll report to our Head of Data and split your time between owning challenging analytical work and guiding a team of data analysts to build and deliver top-tier data products.
This is a high-impact role for someone who thrives on ownership, collaboration, and delivering measurable value. Those with strong analytical skills who are excited to lead teams, build and optimize data workflows, and partner cross-functionally to shape and execute on product strategy are encouraged to apply.
As a Data Lead, You Will:
Own data strategy and execution for a portfolio of high-impact data products for investors , driving product success through a focus on accuracy, client value, and efficiency and partnering closely with research and commercial leaders to set and hit ambitious targets
Operate as a player-coach , setting a high bar for quality, speed, and innovation while coaching, empowering, and inspiring your team to do their best work.
Work with massive amounts of data to help answer investor key questions
about the sectors we cover and datasets we analyze. You will learn about our proprietary methods and techniques to ensure data accuracy and derive key insights.
Tackle complex data problems,
using your analytical skills to optimize methodologies, test new datasets, and solve data-related problems that require innovative solutions
Drive standardization, simplification, and improvements to our data pipelines
and workflows to minimize risk and maximize efficiency and value
Partner cross-functionally with other teams
including Research and Engineering to uncover and execute on opportunities to further drive customer value and optimize our processes and pipelines
You Are Likely To Succeed If:
You have 5+ years of experience in data analytics, forecasting, or business intelligence, including 1-2 years in a management or lead capacity
You have 3+ years of experience working with SQL, Python, Pyspark, or other programming languages to explore and transform large, complex datasets; Proficiency with Github and familiarity with Databricks
You have strong communication skills and are able to work and project manage effectively with stakeholders across both technical and non-technical teams
You excel at approaching complex problems logically and decisively, and take pride in implementing scalable solutions
You have a strong ownership and entrepreneurial mentality and are enthusiastic about working with others to make a big impact
Preferred: You’ve worked in or alongside capital markets, investment research, or financial services.
What We Offer:
Our compensation package includes a competitive salary and comprehensive benefit offerings. You’ll work with a New York-based team
Flexible work schedule
Personal laptop
Health and wellness package
Remote work
Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you make, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust.
We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.

title: Executive Operations Integrator
description:
Role: Executive Operations Integrator (Beauty Industry - MUST HAVE EXPERIENCE)
Role Specifics:
We are only considering candidates with experience in the beauty industry. Please only apply if you have worked in the beauty industry/salon space.
Contract:
Full-time Remote Contractor (40 hours weekly / 160 hours monthly)
Business Hours:
Monday to Friday, 8 AM to 5 PM EST
Rate:
$2,000 - $3,000 USD monthly / $24,000 - $36,000 annually
(salary is negotiable based on experience and location)
Availability to Start:
Immediately
Client's Profile
Founded in New Jersey in 1997, this award-winning luxury salon and wellness spa is more than a destination for beauty; it's a space for transformation, self-expression, and connection. With multiple locations and a commitment to continuous growth, they've cultivated a brand rooted in intentional service, elevated aesthetics, and deep care for their clients and team. Grounded in a culture of excellence and evolution, the company is led by a visionary founder who blends business with purpose, creating a salon experience that is as soul-filled as it is stylish. Their dedication to excellence has earned them national recognition, including features in major media outlets and accolades from platforms such as CBS and The Knot.
What You'll Do
As the Executive Operations Integrator, this role is not a traditional operations assistant role, and it's not suited for a traditional candidate. The client is building more than a business. They are nurturing a vision of trust, growth and collaborative improvement. As the Executive Operations Integrator, you are the trusted partner who supports the founder from behind the scenes, with clear systems, executive presence, and emotional intelligence. You don't need to be perfect. But you do need to care deeply. This role blends organizational operations, systems management, and strategic support. You'll facilitate team meetings, track KPIs, manage tools like Zenoti and Shopify, coordinate marketing tasks, and keep the founder's priorities aligned. This hands-on role is ideal for someone who thrives in structure, demonstrates initiative, and prioritizes clarity and detail. Your responsibilities will include:
Operations & Integrator Coordination: 60% Role Allocation
Team & Operations Management
Be the primary support to the Founder in managing day-to-day operations and overall team integration.
Be the point of contact for internal issues and help with swift resolution.
Help create and implement organizational strategies that support company goals.
Lead planning sessions, team meetings, and 1:1s; take notes and follow up on action items.
Manage projects from start to finish, including timelines, budgets, and delivery.
Track team KPIs and tasks, offering support where needed.
Prepare reports on Operations and Team Performance for the Founder.
Identify ways to improve processes and communication, applying emotional intelligence in communication dynamics.
Create and maintain an easy-to-follow Operations Playbook.
System Management & Process Oversight
Manage internal tools like Zenoti and Qnity, including employee logs, credentials, client scheduling, cancellations, promo campaigns, etc.
Oversee inventory and updates in Zenoti and Shopify, ensuring stock is correct and within budget.
Review reports and workflows to find and fix inefficiencies.
Marketing & Content Coordination: 25% Role Allocation
Marketing Coordination
Coordinate marketing tasks across departments to keep campaigns on track.
Oversee the submission and organization of marketing materials, advertisements, and promotions within Zenoti and Shopify.
Content Curation & Social Media Management
Support social media efforts by duplicating and scheduling content (IG, FB, , Google) to align with business initiatives.
Write simple copy, quotes, or weekly updates as needed, ensuring consistent brand tone.
Monitor engagement and share relevant content ideas as needed.
Strategic Founder & Client Support: 10% Role Allocation
Own the Founder's calendar, meetings, and priorities; give daily updates.
Keep the Founder's email inbox organized, respond to messages, and track follow-ups.
Turn the Founder's ideas (notes or voice memos) into actionable tasks.
Protect the Founder's time while supporting the team and aligning priorities.

description:
Quem somos nós?

soluções inovadoras

espaço aberto e livre

Se você deseja estar em um ambiente colaborativo, desafiador e que incentiva você a sempre evoluir e ser o protagonista da sua história, aqui é o seu lugar!

CLT

Remoto

das 9h às 12h e das 13h às 18h. A jornada é flexível conforme agendas e entregas.

Meios de Comunicação:

O que buscamos?
Estamos em busca de um/uma
DevOps
para fazer parte de nosso movimento. Quem ocupar esta posição será responsável por gerenciar o ciclo de vida completo de aplicações, desde o desenvolvimento até a entrega em produção, garantindo eficiência e agilidade por meio da automação e de metodologias ágeis.
Como será seu dia-a-dia?
Seu dia-a-dia será dinâmico e desafiador, com atividades que envolvem desde o desenvolvimento de pipelines de integração e entrega contínuas, até a manutenção de infraestrutura cloud. Você terá a oportunidade de atuar em empresas de grande porte, auxiliando a equipe a alcançar resultados mais rápidos e eficientes através da adoção de metodologias ágeis e da automação de processos.

Gerenciar e manter ambientes de infraestrutura cloud;
Implementar e gerenciar soluções de infraestrutura como código (IaC), utilizando ferramentas como Terraform, CloudFormation ou Azure Resource Manager;

Criar e manter scripts de automação para tarefas rotineiras e de configuração;
Identificar oportunidades de melhoria contínua no processo de entrega de software e implementação de otimizações;
Resolver incidentes e problemas de produção de maneira rápida e eficaz, garantindo a estabilidade dos sistemas;
Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares e comunicar-se efetivamente com outras áreas da empresa.
Para cumprir esse desafio, você precisa dominar:
Experiência com plataformas de orquestração de containers, como Kubernetes, Docker Swarm ou Openshift;
Conhecimento em ferramentas de gestão de configuração, como Ansible, Puppet e Chef;
Experiência em linguagens de programação, como Python, Ruby ou Go, para automatizar tarefas e desenvolver pipelines de CI/CD;
Conhecimento em práticas DevOps e metodologias ágeis;
Familiaridade com infraestruturas cloud, como AWS, Azure ou GCP;
Experiência com ferramentas de monitoramento (Observabilidade) e gerenciamento de LOGs, como Datadog, NewRelic, Dynatrace, Prometheus, Grafana e Elasticsearch;
Experiência com a prática de infraestrutura como código, utilizando ferramentas como Terraform, CloudFormation e/ou Azure Resource Manager para provisionar e gerenciar infraestrutura cloud.

Programa de Pontos Flexíveis em seu Caju -
um valor fléxivel para você usar como você quiser;

Seguro de vida.
